content:
Nora Lee: Heads-up — partner sync recap: planned joint roadmap announce (H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi) but we need a leakage contingency and marketplace-split plan.
Diego Rivera: for marketplace-split, are we doing simultaneous publish across AWS/GCP/Azure or staggered by region?
Nora Lee: prefer simultaneous if all images pass smoke, otherwise stagger by provider: AWS -> GCP -> Azure, 30m gaps.
Priya Shah: SI raised concern about telemetry parity across providers. If telemetry differs we can't guarantee identical performance claims. Need a short note in comms.
Kostas Vasil: Agree. Also flagging firmware signing window — partners want final signing at Mon 4pm PT. After that only critical fixes.
Emily Tran: Marketing wants an embargo officer contact for each partner. Can partnerships provide name+mobile and 24h backstop?
Nora Lee: I'll provide: NVIDIA: Diego; AMD: Priya; Habana: Kostas. Mobile numbers in DM.
partner-bot: Marketplace image status: aws-h100: ready, gcp-h100: ready, azure-h100: pending; aws-mi300: pending QAT, gcp-mi300: ready, gaudi: kernel patch required.
Diego Rivera: action: Eng-Infra to run cross-provider publish dry-run Tue 9am PT. Can infra simulate marketplace publish and rollback?
Kostas Vasil: infra can simulate publish to a staging repo but not the actual marketplaces. We'll need partner test accounts to exercise the real flows.
Priya Shah: SI will run telemetry parity check: we compare token throughput and error rates across providers. Simple script below: 
```
python tools/telemetry_diff.py --baseline aws --compare gcp,azure --window 5m --metrics latency,qps,errors
```
Diego Rivera: good. Also, contingency if embargo leak occurs: we have two paths — (A) pre-announce to partners and marketplace earlier (no public blog), (B) accelerate public blog with redacted partner mentions. Which should we prefer?
Nora Lee: prefer (A) for control. Only use (B) if data shows a full leak and legal signs off. Document escalation.
Emily Tran: Marketing needs a hold-release checklist: legal ok, embargo officers acked, marketplace tags verified, SI telemetry green, perf snapshots attached.
Kostas Vasil: For the gaudi kernel patch: owner assigned (git issue #4521). Patch must land and nightlies pass by Mon 10pm PT or we hold gaudi from the initial publish.
Priya Shah: SI smoke window proposal: Wed 6:30am PT run (short suite) then Wed 8:00am PT full run. Need images by Tue 8pm PT.
Diego Rivera: I'll ask partners to push images by Tue 6pm; ask infra to produce image digests and attestations.
partner-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2025-04-01 09:00PT. Embargo officer reminders scheduled for 2025-04-01 07:00PT.
Nora Lee: quick risk list: 1) azure publish delay (low). 2) mi300 QAT flakiness (med). 3) gaudi kernel patch (high). Priorities: fix gaudi, stabilize MI300 QAT.
Emily Tran: I'll prepare two press intro paragraphs: one full (all partners) and one limited (no MI300/gaudi). Will circulate by Tue 11am.
Kostas Vasil: if gaudi falls out, we need to update marketplace tags and SKU docs to remove gaudi-v1 and add a note.
Priya Shah: I'll create the SI result template with pass/fail checklist and attach to runbook.
Nora Lee: great. Final ask: partners confirm image availability and acknowledege embargo officer contacts by Mon EOD. I'll follow up in DMs.
Diego Rivera: pinged NVIDIA PMs.
Kostas Vasil: pinged Habana engineering.
Emily Tran: confirmed comms schedule.
partner-bot: Thread snapshot saved. Reply in-thread for urgent updates. :white_check_mark:
